args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build's
tests/test_money.py to fail. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the spec.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `round_money` quantizes to cents using banker's rounding, matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (includes `test_half_even`, which asserts `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` and `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`).
